item.title: I asked an AI to do a trained model's job. Here is what it got right and wrong
item.dc:creator: Denver Asuncion
item.description: A zero-shot LLM and a trained logistic regression scored about the same on 194 telecom customers. The more informative result was where they disagreed, and whether the LLM's reasons held up.
